permutation_importance_protocol.name: GROUP_PRESERVING_CONTINUOUS_FEATURE_PERMUTATION_IMPORTANCE
permutation_importance_protocol.scientific_role: POST-HOC MODEL INTERPRETABILITY; NOT CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION
permutation_importance_protocol.ice_status_policy: EXCLUDED FROM GENERIC PERMUTATION RANKING; interpreted separately through the prospectively frozen P2-A6 counterfactual branch.
permutation_importance_protocol.permutation:
For feature k and repeat r, independently permute feature k only within each
exact-pair x observed-configuration stratum. All other predictors, targets,
identities, and ice_status remain unchanged.
permutation_importance_protocol.rationale: Preserves exact-pair/configuration distributions while breaking within-stratum pointwise association for one continuous predictor.
permutation_importance_protocol.execution: For each repeat, stack all 8 single-feature-permuted cohorts and perform one model.predict call; total planned permutation predict calls = 20.
permutation_importance_protocol.baseline: frozen P2-A5B-R1 unpermuted locked predictions; do not recompute baseline
permutation_importance_protocol.metric: same P2-A5 locked PAIR-MACRO TARGET-MACRO DEVELOPMENT-SCALE NRMSE
permutation_importance_protocol.feature_importance_estimand: DeltaNRMSE_k = permuted primary NRMSE - frozen baseline primary NRMSE
permutation_importance_protocol.pair_level_estimand: For each exact pair and feature, average pair-macro DeltaNRMSE across the 20 deterministic permutation repeats.

classification.supported_dependency: 95% exact-pair bootstrap CI lower bound for pair-macro mean DeltaNRMSE > 0

permutation_importance_protocol.rank_rule: Descending pair-macro mean DeltaNRMSE; ranking is descriptive and does not imply causal importance.

native_importance_protocol.name: EXTRATREES_MEAN_DECREASE_IN_IMPURITY
native_importance_protocol.reason_not_primary: Impurity importance can favor predictors with greater split opportunity and does not quantify locked-cohort predictive damage.
native_importance_protocol.comparison: Report rank concordance with group-preserving permutation ranking using Spearman rho; no significance claim.
native_importance_protocol.ice_status: May be shown in native importance table, but must not be directly rank-equated to the P2-A6 physical counterfactual contrast.

ensemble_dispersion_protocol.name: EXTRATREES_TREE_ENSEMBLE_DISPERSION_DIAGNOSTIC
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.scientific_role: UNCERTAINTY DIAGNOSTIC / EPISTEMIC-PROXY ONLY; NOT A CALIBRATED PREDICTION INTERVAL
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.target_space: standardized six-target model-output space using frozen P2-A4E development-only target scales
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.row_level_dispersion: u_ij = standard deviation across the 256 tree predictions for row i and target j
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.pair_target_dispersion: U_gj = RMS of u_ij across rows within exact pair g for target j
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.pair_target_error: E_gj = frozen P2-A5B-R1 NRMSE for exact pair g and target j
ensemble_dispersion_protocol.target_specific_association: For each of six targets, Spearman rho across 24 exact pairs between U_gj and E_gj

interpretation_rule.positive_association: 95% bootstrap CI lower bound for Spearman rho > 0

ensemble_dispersion_protocol.pooled_target_correlation: PROHIBITED as primary because targets are heterogeneous; six target-specific associations are primary diagnostics.

support_error_protocol.name: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT_DISTANCE_VS_LOCKED_ERROR
support_error_protocol.support_reference: frozen P2-A6A development-only clean and iced kNN clouds
support_error_protocol.row_support_distance: s_i = max(d_clean_i, d_iced_i), using the frozen 8-D standardized continuous state/control space and k=10
support_error_protocol.pair_support_distance: S_g = median s_i across rows within exact pair g
support_error_protocol.association: Spearman rho across 24 exact pairs between S_g and pair-macro NRMSE
support_error_protocol.interpretation: Positive association suggests degradation as the locked pair moves farther from development support; absence of association is not evidence of universal robustness.

claim_policy.interpretability_scope: Predictive dependence of the frozen model within the locked dataset; not physical causation.
claim_policy.feature_importance_scope: Continuous-feature permutation importance and native forest importance are model diagnostics, not aerodynamic derivative estimates.
claim_policy.ice_status_scope: Physical interpretation of ice_status remains governed by P2-A6; generic permutation ranking does not replace the counterfactual common-support analysis.
claim_policy.uncertainty_scope: Tree dispersion is an ensemble-disagreement diagnostic and epistemic proxy, not a calibrated uncertainty interval.
claim_policy.support_scope: Support-distance association is a validity diagnostic, not a universal domain-of-applicability guarantee.
prohibited_claims: physical sensitivity derivative from permutation importance
post-hoc model retuning based on interpretability results
manuscript_reporting: primary continuous-feature permutation-importance ranking with exact-pair bootstrap intervals
secondary native ExtraTrees importance and rank concordance
explicit separation of P2-A6 ice-status counterfactual physics evidence from generic feature importance

next_stage: P2-A7B execute frozen group-preserving permutation importance, native forest importance, tree-ensemble dispersion/error diagnostics, and support-distance/error diagnostics. No model training/refit or protocol changes.
